key_insight: A fully local, two-stage MedGemma pipeline can extract CRF data from EHR notes while reducing hallucinations through evidence-based presence and value separation.
clinical_relevance: This offers a privacy-preserving, on-premise approach for clinical data extraction that can support CRF completion without sending sensitive text to external APIs.
method: Binary stage first classifies whether each item is present, negated, uncertain, or unknown.
Value stage extracts item-specific values only when textual evidence supports presence.
Uses local, domain-adapted few-shot in-context learning with MedGemma-27B and no fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: On the official English test track, the system achieved a macro-F1 of 0.55 and ranked second among locally hosted open-source submissions.
watch_item: Performance is promising but still below top proprietary systems, and the item-specific prompt design may be complex to maintain across new CRF schemas.
paper_title: sebis at CRF Filling 2026: A Two-Stage Local LLM Pipeline for Medical CRF Filling
